186: func buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(nodeType string, override *Component) []componentCfgLine {
187: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefaultComponents[canonicalSrosNodeType(nodeType)]

189: 		return nil
190: 	}
191: 	if override == nil {
192: 		override = &Component{}

194:

196: 
197: 	if len(override.XIOM) > 0 {
198: 		defaultMdas = nil
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	card := &Component{
202: 		Slot: integratedSrosCardSlot,

205: 		MDA:  mergeIntegratedMdas(defaultMdas, override.MDA),
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	return buildComponentCfgLines([]*Component{card}, "")
209: }

211: func mergeIntegratedMdas(defaults, overrides MDAS) MDAS {
212: 	bySlot := map[int]string{}
213: 	for _, mda := range slices.Concat(defaults, overrides) {
214: 		if mda.Slot > 0 && mda.Type != "" {
215: 			bySlot[mda.Slot] = mda.Type
216: 		}
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	slots := slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(bySlot))
220: 	mdas := make(MDAS, 0, len(slots))
221: 	for _, slot := range slots {
222: 		mdas = append(mdas, MDA{Slot: slot, Type: bySlot[slot]})
223: 	}
224: 	return mdas

242: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefault(nodeType)
243: 	if !ok || len(component.allowedSlots) == 0 {
244: 		return []string{slotAName}
245: 	}
246: 	return component.allowedSlots

250: 	if !isIntegratedSrosNodeType(nodeType) || len(components) < 2 {

252: 	}

256: 		}
257: 	}

263: 	if slot == "" {
264: 		slot = standaloneSlotName
265: 	}

270: 	if !n.kindSpecificCfg().GenComponentConfig {
271: 		return ""
272: 	}

275: 	}

277: 	if isIntegratedSrosNodeType(n.Cfg.NodeType) {

281: 	components := n.rootComponents

284: 	}

286: 	for _, c := range components {

294: 				"node",

296: 				"slot",
297: 				slot,
298: 			)
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	lines := buildComponentCfgLines(n.componentsForConfig(components), n.componentSFM())
303: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
304: }
305: 
306: // hardwareEnv is the topology env, which overrides component type, XIOM, and MDA.
307: // Nodes that have not been through Init expose that env on Cfg.Env.
308: func (n *sros) hardwareEnv() map[string]string {
309: 	if n.userEnv != nil {
310: 		return n.userEnv
311: 	}
312: 	return n.Cfg.Env
313: }
314: 
315: // componentSFM is the SFM used in generated config. NOKIA_SROS_SFM overrides the sfm key.
316: func (n *sros) componentSFM() string {

318: 		return sfm
319: 	}
320: 	return n.kindSpecificCfg().SFM
321: }

323: // componentForConfig clones c and applies per-component env, then node env.
324: func (n *sros) componentForConfig(c *Component) *Component {
325: 	out := cloneComponent(c)
326: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, out.Env)
327: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, n.hardwareEnv())
328: 	return out
329: }

331: func (n *sros) componentsForConfig(components []*Component) []*Component {
332: 	out := make([]*Component, len(components))
333: 	for i, c := range components {
334: 		out[i] = n.componentForConfig(c)
335: 	}
336: 	return out

339: func (n *sros) componentConfigFromLines(lines []componentCfgLine) string {
340: 	powerConfig := n.generatePowerConfig()

362: 			"card",
363: 			card,
364: 		)
365: 		return ""
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	lines := buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(
369: 		n.Cfg.NodeType,
370: 		n.componentForConfig(n.integratedComponentOverride()),
371: 	)
372: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
373: }

375: // integratedComponentOverride returns the component that overrides the integrated defaults:
376: // the single component of a standalone node, or the component matching the slot of a
377: // redundant CPM node.
378: func (n *sros) integratedComponentOverride() *Component {
379: 	if n.rootCtrName == "" {

382: 		}

384: 	}

386: 	slot := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]

389: 			return c
390: 		}
391: 	}

# PR Review: SR-SIM components model refactor, chassis_info validation, new chassis types, CI sharding

**Head:** `d44c69f` · **Base:** `84cf630` · Scope: 31 changed paths (13 files under `nodes/sros/`, schema generator + `clab.schema.json`, docs/README, CI workflow, robot tests).

## Summary

This PR is primarily a well-executed refactor of `nodes/sros`: template/config/power/netns/variant logic moves out of the oversized `sros.go` into focused files, and a new `chassis_info.go`-driven advisory validation layer is added. I verified the load-bearing behavior changes end-to-end:

- **Classification routing** is coherent: `isDistributedBaseNode` now returns true for integrated types with redundant components (`ixr-r6` A+B), while `setupStandaloneComponents` still errors for the same input on a standalone path; component nodes strip their `Components` (`kindSpecificConfig.Of(componentConfig).Components = nil`) so they classify as distributed cards and cannot recurse.
- **Env precedence** is consistent with the documented model: `userEnv` is snapshotted before component/SFM flags are applied (`sros.go:263-275`), component nodes inherit it (`sros.go:688`), and `keepUserEnv`/`warnUserEnvOverrides`/`applyHardwareEnv` implement "node env wins over per-component env wins over derived types" with warnings. `componentDerivedEnv` correctly folds in per-component `c.Env`.
- **Warnings fire once per lab**: `PreDeploy` → `createSROSFiles` runs only for standalone nodes and distributed CPM cards (`sros.go:410`), and `warnUnsupportedComponents` guards to CPM A (`sros.go:1073-1077`), so neither CPM B nor line cards duplicate warnings.
- **The moved `checkComponentSlotsConfig` actually fixes a base bug**: base inserted the raw slot into the dedup map while checking the uppercased slot; the head version (`component.go:165`) inserts the uppercased slot, so mixed-case duplicates (`a`/`A`) are now rejected.
- **Schema and docs align**: new node types (`ixr-e2sc`, `ixr-e3`, `sar-10x`) and MDA types are present in `clab.schema.json` enums (generated via the updated `sros_schema_gen.sh`, which now derives enums from the chassis table and adds `fixed_mdas` values), and the integrated-default MDA types used by `integratedSrosDefaultComponents` all appear in the schema. `docs/manual/kinds/sros.md` and `nodes/sros/README.md` describe the new components model, the card-override skip behavior, and env override semantics accurately.

No P0–P3 defects were found. Two P4 improvements follow.

## Findings

| Priority | Count |
|----------|-------|
| P0 | 0 |
| P1 | 0 |
| P2 | 0 |
| P3 | 0 |
| P4 | 2 |

### P4 — New `14-srsim-new-chassis.robot` suite is scheduled in CI but always skips there

**Location:** [`.github/workflows/srsim-tests.yml` L51-L52](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/.github/workflows/srsim-tests.yml#L51-L52) and [`tests/13-srsim/14-srsim-new-chassis.robot` L7-L16](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/tests/13-srsim/14-srsim-new-chassis.robot#L7-L16)

**Problem:** The new chassis suite gates itself with `Skip If '${26_10_TESTS}'.lower() != 'true'` and defaults the variable to `false`. Nothing in the repository sets it: `srsim-tests.yml` invokes `./tests/rf-run.sh ${{ inputs.runtime }} ./tests/13-srsim/${test_suite}` with no `--variable` flag and no input that could carry one, yet the `components` shard lists `14-srsim-new-chassis.robot`.

**Trigger:** Every CI run of the `components` shard.

**Impact:** The new-chassis code paths (`ixr-e2sc`, `ixr-e3`, `sar-10x` classification, integrated/distributed routing, component warnings) receive no automated CI coverage; regressions would only surface through manual runs with `--variable 26_10_TESTS:true`. The shard listing overstates actual coverage.

**Suggestion:** Either add a workflow input (or a dedicated shard) that passes `--variable 26_10_TESTS:true` once the 26.10 image is generally available, or remove the suite from the `components` shard until then so the shard reflects reality. If the skip is intentionally permanent until the image ships, a comment in the workflow would make that explicit.

### P4 — SFM override warning in `Init` duplicates `warnUserEnvOverrides` for one key

**Location:** [`nodes/sros/sros.go` L277-L297](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/sros.go#L277-L297)

**Problem:** The inline block reproduces exactly the semantics of `warnUserEnvOverrides` (`component.go:184-202`) — warn when the user env value exists and differs — for the single `NOKIA_SROS_SFM` key, including the identical message format and log fields. `warnUserEnvOverrides` exists precisely for this pattern and is already used two call sites later.

**Trigger:** Any node whose kind config sets `SFM` while the user also sets `NOKIA_SROS_SFM` to a different value.

**Impact:** Two copies of the same warning text/log-field contract to keep in sync; future changes to the message must be made in both places.

**Suggestion:** Replace the inline warn with `warnUserEnvOverrides(n.Cfg.ShortName, map[string]string{envNokiaSrosSFM: sfm}, n.userEnv)` and keep the `n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSFM] = sfm` assignment gated on the key being absent (the helper already computes `userSet`). This is a small local simplification, not a structural change.

## Coverage Notes

- **Complete static review.** All 31 changed paths were read from `diff.txt` in full; head files were cross-checked where the diff was ambiguous (including the complete `utils/sros_schema_gen.sh`, `chassis_info.go`, `component_config.go`, and `component.go`). Tests were **not executed**; all behavioral conclusions are from source inspection and the robot test expectations, not from runs.
- Verified: classification routing for standalone/integrated/redundant/distributed cases; `userEnv` snapshot ordering relative to `setupComponentNodes` (called from `Init` at `sros.go:343`, after the snapshot — correct); single-warning behavior across CPM A/B and line cards; per-component env preservation via `componentDerivedEnv`; schema enum coverage for the new chassis types and integrated-default MDA types; docs/README consistency with the implementation.
- Runtime-dependent behaviors (container creation, netns join, image inspection returning `chassis_info.json`, gnmic queries against distributed-base container names) are inferred from code and test expectations, not verified in a live environment.
- The base `checkComponentSlotsConfig` insertion bug (raw-slot insert vs uppercased check) was fixed as part of the move; no finding was raised for it.
- The package-level `srosEnv` map mutation (`sros.go:309,312`) and SFM-per-line-card config emission are pre-existing patterns carried over unchanged and were not flagged.

Nothing in the repository sets it: [`srsim-tests.yml`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/.github/workflows/srsim-tests.yml#L1-L1) invokes `./tests/rf-run.sh ${{ inputs.runtime }} ./tests/13-srsim/${test_suite}` with no `--variable` flag and no input that could carry one, yet the `components` shard lists [`14-srsim-new-chassis.robot`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/tests/13-srsim/14-srsim-new-chassis.robot#L1-L1). **Trigger:** Every CI run of the `components` shard. **Impact:** The new-chassis code paths (`ixr-e2sc`, `ixr-e3`, `sar-10x` classification, integrated/distributed routing, component warnings) receive no automated CI coverage, and the shard listing overstates actual coverage. Regressions would only surface through manual runs with `--variable 26_10_TESTS:true`. **Suggested correction:** Either add a workflow input (or a dedicated shard) that passes `--variable 26_10_TESTS:true` once the 26.10 image is generally available, or remove the suite from the `components` shard until then. If the skip is intentionally permanent until the image ships, a comment in the workflow would make that explicit. ## P4 - Inline `SFM` override warning in `Init` duplicates `warnUserEnvOverrides` for the `NOKIA_SROS_SFM` key **Location:** [nodes/sros/sros.go:277-297](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/sros.go#L277-L297) **Problem:** The inline block in `Init` reproduces exactly the semantics of `warnUserEnvOverrides` ([`component.go:184-202`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/component.go#L184-L202)) — warn when the user env value exists and differs — for the single `NOKIA_SROS_SFM` key, including the identical message format and log fields. **Trigger:** Any node whose kind config sets `SFM` while the user also sets the `NOKIA_SROS_SFM` environment variable to a different value. **Impact:** Two copies of the same warning text and log-field contract must be kept in sync; a future message change must be applied in both places, which is easy to miss during maintenance. **Suggested correction:** Replace the inline warn with `warnUserEnvOverrides(n.Cfg.ShortName, map[string]string{envNokiaSrosSFM: sfm}, n.userEnv)` and keep the `n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSFM] = sfm` assignment gated on the key being absent (the helper already computes `userSet`). This is a small local simplification, not a structural change. ## Coverage - Static review only; tests were not executed. All 31 changed paths were read from `diff.txt` in full, and head files were cross-checked where the diff was ambiguous (including the complete [`utils/sros_schema_gen.sh`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/utils/sros_schema_gen.sh#L1-L1), [`chassis_info.go`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/chassis_info.go#L1-L1), [`component_config.go`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/component_config.go#L1-L1), and [`component.go`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/component.go#L1-L1)). - Verified: classification routing (standalone/integrated/redundant/distributed), `userEnv` snapshot ordering relative to `setupComponentNodes` (called from `Init` at [`sros.go`](https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/blob/d44c69f72ab156474197f12b6fc1407b3f8a65c4/nodes/sros/sros.go#L1-L1):343, after the snapshot), single-warning behavior across CPM A/B and line cards via the `PreDeploy` gating, per-component env preservation in `componentDerivedEnv`, and schema enum coverage for the new chassis types and integrated-default MDA types. - Runtime-dependent behaviors (container creation, netns join, image inspection returning `chassis_info.json`, gnmic queries against distributed-base container names) are inferred from code and robot test expectations, not verified in a live environment. - The base `checkComponentSlotsConfig` insertion bug (raw-slot insert vs uppercased check) was fixed as part of the move;
